assets.name: frame
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production MapleStory-style mobile game currency balance badge background, blank UI asset. Reference image is a STYLE reference only for shiny illustrated wood and restrained golden bevels. Create ONE front-facing horizontal rounded rectangle, exact silhouette aspect ratio 220:60 (11:3), very thin polished golden metal rim around a deep chocolate brown wooden inset with faint smooth horizontal wood grain. Keep this compact and readable at 220x60 in game. The central inset must be uniformly dark enough for pale cream numbers, with ample plain negative space. Light warm honey highlights along the top edge, darker bronze lower bevel, clean dark outline. Rim maximum about 5% of height. Rounded corners, no extending ornaments or protrusions. No leaves, mushrooms, crystals, diamonds, coins, symbols, buttons, letters, numbers or watermark. Whole rectangle close-cropped and fully visible, genuine transparent exterior with only tiny padding, no cast shadow extending beyond the frame. Matches the supplied glossy cartoon fantasy UI drawing style, crisp clean illustrated finish.

assets.name: plus
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production MapleStory-style mobile game 44x44 plus button. Reference image is a STYLE reference only for glossy illustrated gold trim. Create ONE front-facing compact square button with slightly rounded corners, aspect ratio 1:1. Thin polished golden rim and dark brown outline, vivid emerald green inset with soft lime top highlight and deeper green lower bevel. In its center one very clear thick ivory-white PLUS symbol (+), clean and readable at 44x44. Match the glossy cartoon fantasy game UI style of the reference. No leaves, mushrooms, crystals, other icons, letters, numbers, watermark, extra objects or background. Whole button close-cropped and fully visible, genuine transparent exterior, tiny padding, no cast shadow beyond the silhouette.
